title: 5.1 The Internet and the World Wide Web
description: The Internet and the World Wide Web: definition, history, protocols, DNS, URLs and websites. Hard level, 20 questions.

questions.question: Which term-description pair is correctly matched?
options: IP: addresses packets and selects routes
questions.correctAnswer: IP: addresses packets and selects routes

questions.question: A company needs to host a website and register a domain name. Which type of organization provides both services?
questions.correctAnswer: An Internet Service Provider

questions.question: Why can packets of the same message arrive out of order?
options: IP may route each packet along a different path
TCP numbers the bytes in each segment
The browser renders the page elements in any order
DNS assigns different addresses per packet
questions.correctAnswer: IP may route each packet along a different path

questions.question: Which mechanism lets TCP detect that a segment was lost?
options: An acknowledgment that fails to arrive in time
A sequence number that falls outside the range
A FIN message sent by the receiver
A DNS lookup that returns no address
questions.correctAnswer: An acknowledgment that fails to arrive in time

questions.question: What does the SYN-ACK message indicate in the TCP handshake?
options: Computer B is ready to establish the connection
Computer A has finished sending all of its data
The receiver has lost a data segment
questions.correctAnswer: Computer B is ready to establish the connection

questions.question: Which order correctly lists the DNS lookup steps?
options: Resolver, root server, TLD server, name server
Root server, resolver, name server, TLD server
TLD server, root server, resolver, name server
Name server, TLD server, root server, resolver
questions.correctAnswer: Resolver, root server, TLD server, name server

questions.question: In "https://blog.example.co.uk/shoes/?color=red", which part is the subdomain?
questions.correctAnswer: blog

questions.question: In that same URL, which part is the path or subfolder?
questions.correctAnswer: /shoes/

questions.question: Which statement about IPv4 and IPv6 is accurate?
options: IPv4 uses 32 bits; IPv6 offers a vastly larger address space
IPv6 uses 32 bits; IPv4 offers a vastly larger address space
IPv4 and IPv6 both use 128-bit hexadecimal addresses
IPv4 addresses are written in hexadecimal with colons
questions.correctAnswer: IPv4 uses 32 bits; IPv6 offers a vastly larger address space

questions.question: Why was IPv6 created?
options: IPv4 cannot supply enough unique addresses
IPv4 cannot encrypt data during transmission
IPv4 does not support web browsing
questions.correctAnswer: IPv4 cannot supply enough unique addresses

questions.question: Which ports are associated with HTTP and HTTPS respectively?
A website shows the same fixed content to every visitor. What type of site is it?
questions.correctAnswer: A static website

questions.question: Which of these is a typical use of a static website?
questions.correctAnswer: A documentation site

questions.question: Which security measure encrypts data during transmission?
questions.correctAnswer: SSL/TLS

questions.question: What is the function of a firewall?
options: It guards a network against unauthorized access
It translates domain names to IP addresses
It stores web pages for incoming client requests
It assigns IP addresses to new devices
questions.correctAnswer: It guards a network against unauthorized access

questions.question: Which protocol handles the sending of email between servers?
questions.correctAnswer: SMTP

questions.question: Which components are all part of the Web’s core technologies?
questions.correctAnswer: HTML, HTTP and URL

questions.question: What does Web 2.0 introduce that earlier web pages lacked?
options: Static text and image pages only
Client-server delivery of web pages to users
questions.correctAnswer: User-generated content and social platforms

questions.question: Which statement best describes a web server?
options: It stores and delivers pages using software like Apache
It requests pages from a browser on a client
It translates human-readable URLs into numeric IP addresses
It renders HTML and CSS for each end user
questions.correctAnswer: It stores and delivers pages using software like Apache

questions.question: Which option correctly orders the steps of accessing a web page?
options: Enter URL, DNS lookup, HTTP request, render page
DNS lookup, enter URL, render page, HTTP request
HTTP request, enter URL, DNS lookup, render page
Render page, HTTP request, DNS lookup, enter URL
questions.correctAnswer: Enter URL, DNS lookup, HTTP request, render page
